raw_query: Can I get access to the phoenix-repository repository
notes: MEDIUM-sensitivity resource: the tool itself returns PENDING_APPROVAL, but risk_check (app/agents/nodes.py) only bumps risk_level for HIGH-sensitivity resources, not MEDIUM - so risk_level stays LOW even though the request correctly still ends up AWAITING_APPROVAL. A real, as-built asymmetry worth knowing about.

raw_query: What's the WiFi password for the Dublin office?
notes: Doesn't match any intent's keywords - correctly falls through to OTHER. No single policy document is the 'right' answer, so RAG recall isn't scored for this case.

raw_query: I lost my laptop, what should I do?
notes: KNOWN HARD CASE, expected to be misclassified: the mock classifier checks IT_EQUIPMENT ('laptop', 1 hit) before SECURITY_INCIDENT ('lost my laptop', 1 hit) and only replaces the best match on a STRICT improvement, so equal hit counts don't overturn the earlier match - it predicts IT_EQUIPMENT instead of the correct SECURITY_INCIDENT. Included deliberately: this is a real limitation of the keyword-based mock classifier, not a bug in the eval harness. Downstream fields (tool/risk/status) are null here since they cascade from whichever intent actually gets predicted; RAG recall is still scored, since retrieval runs on the raw query independently of classification.

raw_query: Our team needs a 3D printer for a prototyping project
notes: KNOWN HARD CASE, expected to be misclassified: the mock classifier's IT_EQUIPMENT keyword list ('laptop','monitor','hardware','device','peripheral','keyboard','mouse') doesn't cover '3D printer' or generic equipment wording, so this falls through to OTHER instead of IT_EQUIPMENT. Included deliberately to measure that gap honestly.
